title: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract
summary: Register signed, sandboxed plugin manifests and capability requests without merging plugin and module registry authority.

criteria: A plugin manifest is registered only when its plugin id, manifest version, artifact digest and signature all validate together; any one of them failing makes registration fail-closed.

A third-party or tenant-authored plugin is distinguished from a first-party module: module registration and module manifest ownership stay with module-registry-manifest-contract, while this contract owns only plugin manifest registration.

The manifest declares a capability request that references an externally owned capability id; an unknown capability id is refused at validation and the grant or denial of the request is not decided here.

The manifest declares a sandbox profile and a resource budget, and registration fails-closed when a declared resource budget exceeds the tenant ceiling; the runtime sandbox itself stays with the parent k-plugin scope.

Every registration is scoped to one tenant, an unknown field in the manifest is rejected rather than ignored, and each install, activate, update and remove transition writes an append-only audit record.
The exclusion set is explicit: capability catalog ownership, the authorization decision, identity/authentication and marketplace listing are all owned elsewhere and are never restated here.

risks.desc: Accepting a plugin whose artifact digest or signature does not validate would let forged third-party code execute inside the platform through the registry's own front door.
risks.mitigation: Bind registration to a validated artifact digest, a valid signature and a signer allowlist entry, and prove each refusal with a dedicated negative.

risks.desc: A manifest whose sandbox profile or resource budget is not bound to its tenant would let one tenant's plugin reach another tenant's data or exhaust shared capacity.
risks.mitigation: Scope every manifest, capability request and resource budget to one tenant, fail-closed above the tenant ceiling and keep cross-tenant refusal a fixed negative-test axis.

risks.desc: An update that quietly broadens a capability request would turn a reviewed least-privilege install into an unreviewed privilege escalation.
risks.mitigation: Treat permission widening as a distinct refused transition under default-deny, require human approval for any broadened request and record the diff append-only.

risks.desc: A plugin registry could be misread as authority over module registration, capability catalog ownership, the authorization decision or marketplace listing.
risks.mitigation: Keep the module, capability, authorization, identity and marketplace exclusions explicit in every phase, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

items: The registry admits a plugin manifest keyed by plugin id and manifest version only when its artifact digest and signature validate against an allowed signer.

Girdi is a submitted plugin manifest plus a tenant scope; çıktı is either a registered manifest record with its declared sandbox profile and resource budget, or a fail-closed refusal naming the failing rule.
The manifest declares a capability request referencing an externally owned capability id; an unknown capability id fails validation and no grant is decided here.
Lifecycle coverage spans install, activate, update and remove, and each transition states what the registry validates and writes an append-only audit record.

Kapsam sınırı gereği module registration and module manifest ownership stay with module-registry-manifest-contract, capability catalog ownership stays with the capability registry, and marketplace listing is excluded.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Signature verification against a signer allowlist is the primary control: an unsigned, forged or untrusted-signer artifact is refused before its manifest is stored, which keeps third-party code out of the platform.

Registration is default-deny and least-privilege: a plugin receives only the capability request it explicitly declared, and permission widening on update is a refused transition rather than a silent grant.
Every manifest, capability request and resource budget is bound to one tenant, so a cross-tenant install or reference is refused rather than filtered, which preserves izolasyon.
An unknown field is rejected rather than ignored and each install, activate, update and remove writes an append-only audit record, which keeps a registration attributable and denetim reproducible.
trust root establishment, signer allowlist governance, key rotation and revocation are named obligations that this contract depends on but does not own; identity/authentication is likewise excluded.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed manifest validation katman rather than a separate validator per plugin kind, so admission rules cannot diverge between them.
Digest comparison, signature verification and capability request resolution stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a datastore.

Registration and runtime sandbox execution stay separated; ölü kod and speculative per-vendor manifest dialects are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The signer allowlist is closed and versioned, so admitting a new signer is a reviewed change rather than a registration-time capability the submitter can request.
Least ayrıcalık applies per transition: an update may not read or request more than the install path for the same plugin id, and no secret is reachable from a manifest field.
Resource budget ceilings are enforced per tenant at registration, so a crafted manifest cannot pre-book capacity that the runtime sandbox would later have to honour.
securityOptimization.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: closed versioned signer allowlist, least-privilege transitions without secret reach, per-tenant resource budget ceilings at registration. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for a manifest validation and a separate budget for a capability request resolution over a representative manifest; no measurement is claimed here.
Digest and signature verification dominate registration cost, so the declared budget covers them explicitly rather than assuming a constant-time check.
Capability resolution must avoid N+1 lookups; the declared capability request set is resolved once per manifest rather than once per requested id.
performance.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: per-stage p95 budgets for validation and capability resolution, explicit digest/signature cost, N+1-free capability resolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client may read which plugins are registered for its tenant; a cihaz may not submit, validate or activate a plugin manifest on its own authority.
An offline client displays the last synchronised registration state as stale together with its manifest version, rather than assuming a plugin is still active.
No mobile registration surface is introduced here; rendering registration state stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: server-authoritative registration, stale offline display with manifest version, no mobile registration surface here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future plugin administration surface must present the manifest version, signer and capability request set as keyboard navigable content with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
A registration refusal, such as a broken signature or an unknown capability id, must be announced through an aria live region naming the failing rule.
This contract defines registration semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable manifest provenance, announced registration refusals, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Kubernetes topology for a registry service or a sandbox execution pool remains human-developer work.
Registering or activating a plugin is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a container rebuild; rollback returns to the previous manifest version.

Withdrawing this registry shard means putting back the earlier planning contract and regenerating the projections from it; no installed plugin or sandbox moves, so runtimeDataImpact is none and the NO-GO verdict stands.
deployment.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, plugin activation as an approved data change, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: An install olay may trigger manifest validation and quota assignment, but the parent owns the runtime sandbox reaction and this contract only states what registration validates.
A plugin that triggers another registration forms a chain that stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a lifecycle transition cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same install, activate, update or remove trigger for the same manifest version must be idempotent, and activation always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: validation-on-install events without owning the runtime reaction, depth-bounded chains, idempotent lifecycle replay and approval-gated activation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.

AI cannot register a plugin, cannot widen a capability request and cannot add a signer to the signer allowlist; each of those needs insan onayı, and a third-party artifact additionally requires a step-up review.

Any manifest reaching the lane as sub_prompt is untrusted, the kill switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from registering plugins, widening capability requests or extending the signer allowlist, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases register a manifest whose plugin id, manifest version, artifact digest and signature validate and whose capability request resolves, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove a digest mismatch, a broken signature and a signer outside the signer allowlist are each refused before storage.
Planned negatives prove an unknown capability id, an unknown field and a permission widening update are rejected under default-deny.
Planned negatives prove a resource budget above the tenant ceiling fails-closed and that a cross-tenant install is refused.
Every manifest matrix above stays a plan until a human-approved run actually executes it, and nothing may be written down as passing on the strength of the plan alone.
testing.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: signed-manifest positives, digest/signature/signer negatives, unknown-capability and permission-widening negatives, budget and cross-tenant negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A08 software and data integrity failures is the defining axis: an artifact digest plus signature check against a signer allowlist is required before any plugin manifest is admitted.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by binding each manifest and capability request to one tenant under default-deny, so a cross-tenant install cannot occur.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by declaring the sandbox profile, resource budget ceiling and unknown-field rejection up front, so a crafted manifest cannot become an escalation vector.

Girdi doğrulama is the concrete control for A03 and A08 here: every manifest field is validated against the closed schema before storage, an unknown field is rejected, and each admission or refusal leaves a denetim izi naming the failing rule.
owasp.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A08 via digest and signature integrity, A01 via tenant-bound default-deny registration, A04 via declared sandbox profile, budget ceilings and strict field rejection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-sozlesme with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-plugin] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a registration touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a lifecycle notification arrives as an olay instead.

This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor module-registry-manifest-contract runs 2027-02-02 to 2027-02-21 and predecessor policy-decision-point-contract ends 2028-04-30, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly module-registry-manifest-contract and policy-decision-point-contract, and no parent bağımlılık edge is inherited.
Scope stays inside the registration layer: module registration, capability catalog ownership, the authorization decision, the runtime sandbox and marketplace listing all stay outside.
integration.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-sozlesme to k-plugin, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir the registration state through this contract and may not maintain its own plugin list or reach a doğrudan tablo for manifest fields.
A consumer must carry the manifest version alongside any stored decision about a plugin, so a later audit can tell which manifest produced the behaviour.
Registering a module belongs to module-registry-manifest-contract and deciding a capability grant belongs to policy-decision-point-contract; this contract registers plugin manifests only.
moduleUsage.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: registry-mediated plugin state without local lists or direct table reads, manifest version carried with stored decisions, excluded module registration and grant authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A plugin manifest names a third-party or tenant author, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
A removed plugin's manifest record is retained for its declared saklama süresi so an earlier install stays explainable, while its runtime data removal is a separate owner's obligation.
Manifest versions and lifecycle audit records are retained append-only, and stored registrations evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: third-party author PII classification, retention of removed manifests, append-only version history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include manifest validation latency percentiles, refusal counts by failing rule, permission widening attempt counts and resource budget ceiling breaches on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the plugin id, manifest version and transition kind; signer identity and manifest secrets are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alerts cover a signature verification failure spike, a surge of unknown capability id refusals and repeated permission widening attempts; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: validation and refusal SLIs, redacted plugin-scoped traces, signature-failure and widening-attempt alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unreachable signer allowlist or trust root during validation; the registry degrades to an explicit fail-closed refusal with the prior registration intact, never to a provisional admission.

Registration is idempotent by construction: resubmitting the same plugin id and manifest version with the same artifact digest returns the same result, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot duplicate a plugin.
A repeatedly failing lifecycle transition is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than retried forever, and a circuit breaker protects the shared registry.
reliability.notes: plugin-registry-manifest-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Plugin Registry Manifest Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-closed refusal when trust material is unreachable, idempotent registration with bounded retry, dead-letter routing and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
